value.author: samMularczyk
value.layerInfo: Photocopier toner: blown edges, dither, speckle and drum banding.

exposure: Lightens or darkens the whole page before the toner threshold, the way the copier's exposure dial does.
contrastAmount: How hard midtones are crushed toward black and white. Responds to detail rather than overall brightness.
blurRadius: Radius of the blurred reference, in pixels. Small values pick out fine detail; large values act on broad areas.
edgeBlowout: Toner piling up at boundaries: a dark halo inside an edge, a bright one outside.
threshold: Brightness at which toner stops being laid down. Lower for a lighter copy, higher for a heavier one.
softness: Width of the threshold. Zero is a hard lo-fi cut; raise it to keep some tone in the result.
dither: Pattern that breaks gradients into grain instead of banding. Ordered is the copier-like one; Random reads as a coarser, older machine.
ditherAmount: Strength of the dither. Too much reads as noise rather than toner.
speckle: Blotchy unevenness in the black, so coverage varies the way a tired cartridge does.
speckleScale: Size of the toner blotches. Small values give large soft patches.
banding: Faint horizontal streaks running across the page, as a worn drum produces. Zero by default.
bandingScale: How closely the streaks are spaced down the page.
paperAmount: Fibre grain in the paper, visible only where the paper shows. Zero leaves the stock clean.
paperScale: Size of the paper fibre. The grain is stretched, so it reads as fibre direction rather than plain noise.
paperFolds: Creases radiating from a few seed points, lighting the sheet the toner sits on. The field gives the vector to the nearest crease rather than a distance, so each one perturbs the surface outward from its own origin - which is what makes it read as a fold and not a contour line.
paperCrumples: Faceted buckling, from two jittered cell fields multiplied - one sharp, one soft.
paperFibre: Directional tooth in the stock, lit rather than merely tinted.
paperRelief_: How deep the sheet reads. Steepens the surface normal's own Z rather than remapping the result. Zero on Folds, Crumple and Fibre together switches the model off and costs nothing.
paperSeed: Changes the arrangement of folds and facets.
inkColor: Toner colour. Cyan for blueprint, a flat spot colour for riso.
paperColor: Stock colour. Slightly warm off-white by default.
amount: Mix between the original layer and the copied result.
